column2:
The Bug offensive against Mahanagar has encroached upon a treasured Federation war memorial, located in the center of the city.

This monument is a lasting testament to the valor of the Mobile Infantry and the sacrifices of its heroes. It cannot be allowed to fall to the Arachnid hordes.

column2: The Arachnids have been unable to dent our defenses. Their hordes are now approaching from the northwest – no doubt in a feeble attempt to outflank our troopers.
The war memorial at the heart of Mahanagar - raised to honor those who gave their lives for the Federation - is now surrounded by Arachnids...
Endless hordes keep pouring over the Honshu Bridge, headed toward the site. But reinforcements and heavy firepower are en route to strengthen its defenses.
The war memorial must be preserved at all cost.
It is our duty to honor humanity’s fallen heroes.
With the arrival of substantial reinforcements begins a new phase of the operation: the purge of the Arachnid infestation around the memorial site.

The names of many more heroes will be inscribed upon Mahanagar's war memorial in recognition of its stalwart defense. Their sacrifice has affirmed the momument's value as a place of commemoration, now and always!
Our troopers have just finished clearing the last Bug nests in the district. But now a report comes in about one more Arachnid attack wave - bigger than anything encountered so far!
The Bugs have already built many nests across the district. Each nest destroyed represents another small step to the ultimate liberation of Mahanagar.
